recommendations.title: Win back 'Can't Lose Them' before they are gone for good
recommendations.finding: 358 customers (6.1% of the base) have bought 6 times on average but have not ordered in 338 days. They carry GBP 1,034,451 of historical revenue (6.1% of the total).
recommendations.action: Targeted win-back offer, sequenced email plus phone for the top decile.

recommendations.title: Protect Champions: the revenue base is dangerously concentrated
recommendations.finding: 1,476 customers (25.2%) generate GBP 11,826,035 — 69.2% of all revenue. Losing just 5% of them costs GBP 591,302 in revenue.
recommendations.action: Named account care for the top 200, early-warning alert when a Champion's gap between orders exceeds twice their own norm.
recommendations.assumption: Protecting 5% of Champion revenue at 30% margin

recommendations.title: Convert one-time buyers to a second purchase
recommendations.finding: 1,619 customers (27.7%) ordered exactly once, at a median of GBP 229. They account for only 3.3% of revenue — the single largest untapped group.
recommendations.action: Post-purchase onboarding sequence with a second-order incentive, triggered 30 days after first delivery.
recommendations.assumption: 5% conversion to a second order at median AOV
